The season started on 28 December 2019. 18 teams compete in the league with each club playing each other twice, home and away, with the three clubs at the bottom of the league relegated to the [[Division One League, Ghana|Division One League]].{{cite web|url=https://www.ghanafa.org/premier-league/premier-league-fixtures|title=Premier League Fixtures|website=Ghana FA|accessdate=9 June 2020}} ==Season overview== With 18 clubs participating in the league, this marked the first time since 1980 that more than 16 clubs competed in the top division of Ghanaian football. King Faisal and Great Olympics were readmitted after separate court cases over unhappiness about their relegation from the top-flight in previous seasons.{{cite web|url=https://www.goal.com/en-gh/news/ghana-resolve-to-keep-18-team-premier-league-beyond-2019-20/9ymi03fs7g7o1gre2nzjc8p9w|title=Ghana resolve to keep 18-team Premier League beyond 2019-20|website=Goal.com|date=19 December 2019|accessdate=11 June 2020}} During a council meeting in October 2019 before the season began, the number of relegated teams was reduced from five to three. The GFA announced that the league was suspended on March 15, 2020, in the middle of match-week 15, because of the global [[COVID-19 pandemic]].{{cite web|url=https://www.goal.com/en-gh/news/coronavirus-ghana-football-association-suspends-premier/lj6rk3p2k21u1x0twtmmfz3vz|title=Coronavirus: Ghana Football Association suspends Premier League after presidential directive|website=Goal.com|date=15 March 2020|accessdate=11 June 2020}}{{cite web|url=https://www.goal.com/en-gh/news/coronavirus-aduana-stars-coach-fabin-afraid-to-restart-ghana/155ez1glmsbfc16t6v5qr4drwx|title=Coronavirus: Aduana Stars coach Fabin afraid to restart Ghana Premier League|website=Goal|date=6 June 2020|accessdate=9 June 2020}} On 31 May, the league was further suspended until at least 31 June. On 30 June, the FA had a meeting and cancelled the league due to the COVID-19 pandemic. A meeting was held on 27 August 2020 to determine the start and logistics of the 2020–21 season.{{cite web|url=https://www.goal.com/en-us/news/covid-19-more-blow-for-premier-league-as-ghana-extends-ban/8usari43jmby14fnn1o04qmgq|title=Covid-19: Blow for Premier League as Ghana extends ban on contact sports |website=Goal|date=31 May 2020|accessdate=8 June 2020}} ==Teams== {{cite web|url=https://www.ghanafa.org/premier-league/premier-league-clubs|title= Premier League Clubs|website=Ghana FA|accessdate=8 June 2020}} {| class="wikitable sortable" !
